Hospital Coordinators maintain plans and resources, update resource status and EEIs, respond to requests, participate in after-action reviews, and review reports and metrics. Local Health Departments manage assessments and readiness data, coordinate local response, and monitor community preparedness. Regional Coordinators review facility readiness, monitor gaps and resource status, and coordinate regional response and recovery. Incident Command Staff prepare for activation, manage incidents and assign tasks, and capture lessons learned. KDHE Administrators configure the system,

manage users and facilities, oversee statewide operations, and run statewide reporting and analytics. Executive Leadership monitors readiness, response effectiveness, and outcomes to guide strategic direction.

The security design follows a defense-in-depth approach aligned to the RFP Data Security Attachment. Although the RFP excludes PHI, the platform will treat AGENCY data and Restricted-Use Information as sensitive operational data and apply healthcare-grade controls appropriate for public health preparedness operations.

The platform captures both successful and unsuccessful sign-in events and logs administrator activity, data access, changes, deletions, permission changes, and exports. Logs are correlated centrally through Log Analytics and Microsoft Sentinel, and they are made available to KDHE according to the agreed process and retention period.
